query: HRMP aims for 6 percent service-disabled veterans but considers 2 percent more realistic.

facts.text: The Board reported a 6% service-disabled-veteran aspiration for Metropolitan Park's operational workforce.
The Board reported 2% as HRMP's more realistic forecast for the operational service-disabled-veteran share.
The applicant's anticipated workforce breakdown identifies approximately 6% as living with a disability.
The applicant's anticipated workforce breakdown separately identifies approximately 2% veteran status.
The March 2026 operational summary retains the 6% aim but omits the 2% realism clause.
The HRMP license requires reporting on construction and operational workforce demographics.
Regulatory review considers good-faith diversity efforts and allows reasonable deviations.
The applicant reported 2% veteran identification at existing gaming locations in 2024.
CPC publicized a September 2026 Metropolitan Park employment information session.
HRMP's proposed community recruitment channels included service-disabled veterans.
The applicant's construction participation metric uses FTE hours worked.
The applicant separately made a 6% supplier utilization commitment for service-disabled-veteran-owned businesses.

conditions.text: The measured operational workforce at HRMP reached its 6% service-disabled-veteran hiring aspiration, using project-specific employees and a defined denominator.

reference_verdict.reasoning: Recommend Target / goal and Medium confidence. Partial corroboration concerns reconstruction of the promise, not attainment. A 6% aspiration and 2% forecast can coexist, while applicant disability and general-veteran categories leave the SDV basis unresolved. The later report changes operational wording without proving an approved amendment. License reporting and good-faith duties are binding, but no operational SDV numerator, denominator or achieved percentage was located. Recruitment publicity, construction hours, existing-property veteran data and supplier participation do not verify the operational target.

sources.title: GFLB Selection Document
sources.specific_evidence: Places the 6% service-disabled-veteran aspiration and 2% realistic expectation in the operational workforce paragraph. The Board characterizes applicants' diversity promises as best-efforts pledges. A higher goal and lower feasibility forecast are not inherently contradictory.
sources.notes: Preserve the historical statement. Do not treat either percentage as an achieved workforce rate or as a supplier-spending measure.

sources.title: Applicant anticipated workforce composition
sources.publisher: Queens Future / Hard Rock Metropolitan Park; hosted by GFLB
sources.specific_evidence: Separately labels approximately 6% as living with a disability and 2% as veteran status. The projected composition is qualified as an aspirational long-term forecast supported by good-faith efforts, rather than a directly measured SDV workforce rate.
sources.notes: Disability and general veteran categories do not identify service-connected disability. A direct SDV classification and defined denominator are required.

sources.title: GFLB Report and Findings
sources.citation: March2026; PDF p.4 disclaimer; p.32 operations; p.89 construction
sources.locator: March2026; PDF p.4 disclaimer; p.32 operations; p.89 construction
sources.specific_evidence: The main operational paragraph retains a minimum 6% SDV aim but omits the 2% realism clause. The construction appendix still discusses a 6% goal and approximately 2% forecast. The report cautions that summaries can differ from application material.
sources.notes: Omission of the operational 2% clause is not proof of an approved amendment; the remaining construction forecast has a different phase.

sources.title: Queens Future executed form gaming license
sources.citation: Dec.19, 2025 letter; PDF p.4 Exhibit1 and General Condition3
sources.locator: Dec.19, 2025 letter; PDF p.4 Exhibit1 and General Condition3
sources.specific_evidence: Requires material performance consistent with application and CAC commitments and public progress reports containing construction and operational workforce demographics. The five-page license does not expressly fix this row's 6% or 2% numerical SDV employment term.
sources.notes: General incorporation and reporting duties do not independently resolve the operative category or guarantee attainment of a specific percentage.

sources.title: NYSGC casino gaming rules
sources.citation: Updated Dec.31, 2025; PDF pp.61-63 Part5312; p.32 Rule5301.10(a)
sources.locator: Updated Dec.31, 2025; PDF pp.61-63 Part5312; p.32 Rule5301.10(a)
sources.specific_evidence: Requires annual Commission-approved diversity plans, self-assessment and performance reports. Compliance review considers commitment consistency, reasonable deviations and good-faith efforts; material workforce changes require written approval. A numerical shortfall alone does not establish a regulatory violation.
sources.notes: No HRMP-specific approved diversity plan or approved 2% replacement was located. Missing public evidence does not prove noncompliance.

sources.title: Applicant historical workforce demographics
sources.citation: June25, 2025 document; revised-redaction copy; PDF pp.2,4 footnote2
sources.locator: June25, 2025 document; revised-redaction copy; PDF pp.2,4 footnote2
sources.specific_evidence: Reports 2% veteran identification across existing gaming locations in 2024. Footnote2 says accurate service-disabled-veteran data was not formally collected each year and total veteran-status measurement began in 2023. These figures do not measure HRMP operational SDV attainment.
sources.notes: Existing-property, all-veteran data uses a different population from HRMP and does not verify the row's lower forecast.

sources.title: CPC employment information session announcement
sources.specific_evidence: Advertises a September29, 2026 employment information session with the HRMP hiring team covering current and upcoming opportunities. This external participating partner announcement supports recruitment publicity, not attendance, completed hires or an SDV-specific employment outcome.
sources.notes: An event announcement is not a post-event results report. No SDV count, workforce denominator or achieved percentage is supplied.

sources.title: Applicant job opportunities submission
sources.publisher: Queens Future / Hard Rock Metropolitan Park; hosted by GFLB
sources.specific_evidence: Describes community-partner recruitment intended to include service-disabled veterans and lists CPC among the partners. The plan links the intended recruitment channel to later external publicity, but does not quantify hires, retention or project-specific SDV composition.
sources.notes: Applicant-origin plan and MOU descriptions remain distinct from measured implementation. Do not infer an achieved employment percentage from a partnership.

sources.title: Applicant construction workforce goals
sources.publisher: Queens Future / Hard Rock Metropolitan Park; hosted by GFLB
sources.specific_evidence: Describes the combined construction workforce participation target using a ratio of total FTE hours worked. This construction measure is separate from the operational workforce composition in H030 and cannot supply its missing employee denominator or achieved SDV rate.
sources.notes: Construction hours are not interchangeable with operational headcount or FTEs. Supplier contract shares are another separate measure.

sources.title: October executive summary supplement
sources.citation: Oct.14, 2025; PDF p.5; duplicate tracked version p.10
sources.publisher: Queens Future / Hard Rock Metropolitan Park; hosted by GFLB
sources.locator: Oct.14, 2025; PDF p.5; duplicate tracked version p.10
sources.specific_evidence: Separately commits to a 6% service-disabled-veteran-owned-business utilization goal alongside 30% MWBE utilization. The supplier-oriented pledge addresses business participation, rather than the proportion of employees who are service-disabled veterans, and cannot verify H030 employment performance.
sources.notes: Keep the SDVOB business goal separate from SDV employee composition. The tracked version is a duplicate, not independent corroboration.
